description: This PHP source file defines the class `FormatWithNationality` which implements functionality to format a nationality value based on an ID, using the `NationalityService` to retrieve nationality information and returning the name of the nationality.

classes.name: FormatWithNationality
classes.description: A class that formats a nationality value given an ID by retrieving the corresponding nationality name via `NationalityService`.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the nationality name corresponding to the provided ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of `NationalityService`.
